Message: Florence is trapped in a cave.

And worse still,
she’s just lying there helpless
because a cursed creature
poisoned her...

Yet, to think I’d let myself
take off running
without even knowing
where she is...

Normally, I’d never do something
without thinking it over.
But, my heart took the reins
before that could even happen.

Once I heard that
she was in danger,
there was just no way
I could allow myself
to keep still within
the safe walls
of the mansion.

Was that voice...Florence’s?
But wait—why does
she sound so sad?

I ran towards the voice
until I came upon a cave,
its entrance sealed off
by giant boulders.

With so many piled
on top of one another,
I feared it would be impossible
for Florence to escape.

Just as I was about to
call out to her, I heard...
